using System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshalling;

namespace SlangShaderSharp.Internal;

[CustomMarshaller(typeof(CustomMarshallerAttribute.GenericPlaceholder), MarshalMode.Default, typeof(NoFreeComInterfaceMarshaller<>))]
internal static class NoFreeComInterfaceMarshaller<T> where T : class
{
	public unsafe static void* ConvertToUnmanaged(T? managed)
	{
		return ComInterfaceMarshaller<T>.ConvertToUnmanaged(managed);
	}

	public unsafe static T? ConvertToManaged(void* unmanaged)
	{
		return ComInterfaceMarshaller<T>.ConvertToManaged(unmanaged);
	}

	public unsafe static void Free(void* unmanaged)
	{
	}
}
